name: TIM
verdict: Owned by the Italian state through Poste Italiane: Poste holds 66.6% of TIM, and is in turn ~65% held by the Ministry of the Economy and Finance and CDP. Nothing found: no record claim for Italy in this dataset.
note: Listed on Ducati's 'Partner & Sponsor' page for the Ducati Lenovo Team (page archived 12 Dec 2025). (Main Partner, tim.it). Rating note: an Italian state-controlled sponsor; state ownership alone, without a sourced record of serious abuses by that state, is not a rating per METHOD.md.
